description: This file defines the WidgetTypeService interface, which declares methods for managing widget types within the Thingsboard platform, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and updates related to widget types and their associations with widget bundles.

classes.name: WidgetTypeService
classes.description: Interface for managing widget types, including CRUD operations and retrieval based on various filters.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a WidgetType by tenant ID and widget type ID.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeDetailsById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a WidgetType by tenant ID and widget type ID.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves widget type info by tenant ID and widget type ID.

methods.name: widgetTypeExistsByTenantIdAndWidgetTypeId
methods.description: Checks if a widget type exists for a given tenant ID and widget type ID.

methods.name: saveWidgetType
methods.description: Saves or updates a WidgetTypeDetails object.

methods.name: deleteWidgetType
methods.description: Deletes a widget type by tenant ID and widget type ID.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetTypesByPageLink
methods.description: Finds system widget types based on filter and pagination.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetTypesByTenantIdAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds all tenant widget types for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetTypesByTenantIdAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds tenant widget types with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget types associated with a specific widget bundle.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesDetailsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget type details associated with a widget bundle.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesInfosByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget type info by widget bundle with options for full search and filtering.

methods.name: findWidgetFqnsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Retrieves fully qualified names of widgets in a bundle.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeByTenantIdAndFqn
methods.description: Finds a widget type by tenant ID and fully qualified name.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeDetailsByTenantIdAndFqn
methods.description: Finds widget type details by tenant ID and fully qualified name.

methods.name: updateWidgetsBundleWidgetTypes
methods.description: Updates widget types associated with a widget bundle.

methods.name: updateWidgetsBundleWidgetFqns
methods.description: Updates widget FQNs associated with a widget bundle.

methods.name: deleteWidgetTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all widget types for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteWidgetTypesByBundleId
methods.description: Deletes widget types associated with a specific widget bundle.

methods.name: findAllWidgetTypesIds
methods.description: Retrieves all widget type IDs with pagination.
